claim_boundary: Synthetic native-window mechanism panel. This report does not establish natural-task utility, LM health or cross-model generalization. Model identity comes from the launch preparation receipt (model path and config identity); checkpoint weights are not rehashed. Runtime equality is checked for recorded contract fields.

halfturn.checkpoint_identity_basis: same trusted local checkpoint path and config; weights are not rehashed

native.checkpoint_identity_basis: same trusted local checkpoint path and config; weights are not rehashed

statistics.bootstrap: resample group_id worlds with replacement within each task x length; keep all four rows and both arms together; reuse draws across metrics; 2.5/97.5 percentile interval
statistics.contrast: condition_1_minus_0=(second-condition query mean)-(first-condition query mean); its candidate-minus-baseline effect is the difference-in-differences
statistics.cross_length: equal mean of fixed lengths and tasks is descriptive only; no joint CI because independence across lengths is not assumed
statistics.exact_match: 1[output_text.strip() == sole reference]; no lowercasing, punctuation removal, substring scoring or EOS requirement
statistics.length_macro: equal mean of the two fixed task families, regardless of world counts; independent resampling within each family
statistics.point_estimate: exact observed candidate mean minus baseline mean; never a bootstrap mean
statistics.units: score fractions; multiply effects and intervals by 100 for percentage points
statistics.world_metrics: exact=mean four correctness indicators; all_four=product four; query_pair=mean of the two within-condition products
